description: This header file implements functionality for selectively building PyTorch with a specific set of operators (allowlist), including compile-time checks for operator registration, feature availability, and macros to enforce feature requirements. It manages external dependencies, defines internal utility functions, and provides mechanisms for build-time configuration and validation.

methods.name: allowlist_contains
methods.description: Checks if a given item is present in a semicolon-separated allowlist string.

methods.name: is_build_feature_available
methods.description: Determines if a build feature is available based on compile-time macros.

methods.name: build_feature_required_feature_not_available
methods.description: Function to handle missing required build features, marked as noreturn.

methods.name: op_allowlist_check
methods.description: Checks if an operator name is on the allowlist for registration.

methods.name: schema_allowlist_check
methods.description: Checks if a schema string is on the allowlist.

methods.name: custom_class_allowlist_check
methods.description: Checks if a custom class name is on the allowlist.

methods.name: op_allowlist_contains_name_in_schema
methods.description: Checks if a schema's base name is in the allowlist.
